parties: Nehal Abhay Vakil, Bhairavi Abhay Vakil, Vivek Abhay Vakil; Asian Paints Limited
headline: Vakil family entities file substantial shareholding disclosure under SEBI takeover regulations
sum: Three entities connected to the Vakil family have filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE, indicating a change in substantial shareholding in Asian Paints Limited. The disclosure is a mandatory regulatory filing triggered when promoters or substantial shareholders' stakes cross materiality thresholds under the SEBI Takeover Code.
detail: Nehal Abhay Vakil, Bhairavi Abhay Vakil, and Vivek Abhay Vakil have submitted a disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, signalling a material change in their aggregate shareholding in Asian Paints Limited. The filing is a mandatory disclosure when a person (or group of persons acting in concert) acquires or transfers shares such that their aggregate shareholding crosses the 5% threshold, or when existing substantial shareholders' stakes change materially. The Vakil family are longstanding promoters of Asian Paints; this disclosure may reflect a restructuring, transfer, or consolidation within the promoter group. No open offer has been announced, suggesting the disclosure may relate to a consolidation within the promoter group or a transaction qualifying for exemption under the Takeover Code.
